children: Treasure Global, through its subsidiary Tadaa Technologies, entered into a software development agreement with Techcom Vintage to build a government fertilizer-subsidy traceability and AI agriculture platform. Tadaa will pay fixed fees of RM8 million in six milestones, with final integration and handover due within 10 months and hardware, documentation, and post-delivery support included. The platform is intended to support subsidy programs administered by participating government bodies.
